description.en: Conservative fossil-informed whole-living static supporting prop; skeletal restoration is not certainty about soft-tissue shape or living appearance. Pose, colors and nominal authored dimensions are artistic. Independently reviewed at environment-prop scale; not museum precision, hero, rigged or animated anatomy.
